findings.detail: Customer, account and card fields are adapted from a supplied internal synthetic TauBench fixture. They are not real customer data. Policy consolidation, graph links, state gates, false summits and audit actions are DetourBench-authored. The upstream package is marked confidential/internal-only; this frozen task must not be redistributed or described as a public corpus.

basis.Breadth: identity, account, status-filtered inventory, card detail, verification and policy are jointly required
basis.Depth: three ordered writes plus audit follow card resolution
basis.Currency: the in-force policy, not the superseded generic policy, governs status eligibility
basis.Disposition: one requested reset and two plausible but irreversible closure choices lead to distinct outcomes
